# Pitex 1.0.5

This release makes the PDF preview on Ubuntu and Windows scroll continuously
through the document, like the macOS preview.

## Changes

- The Ubuntu and Windows PDF preview now stacks pages in a single continuous
  column, so scrolling moves through the whole document instead of changing
  pages only with the toolbar buttons.
- A mostly vertical drag with the primary mouse button pans the preview like
  a hand tool. Sideways drags still select text, and the previous and next
  page buttons remain.
- Installing the Pi assistant on macOS, Ubuntu and Windows keeps Pi 1.0.2 on
  its matching pi-codemode 1.0.2 dependency, so a newer pi-codemode release
  no longer breaks the installed assistant.
- Fix a process-liveness race in build tests and add a Linux development
  environment for repository checks. These changes do not affect the
  application's behavior.

## Install

Pitex 1.0.0 through 1.0.4 update to 1.0.5 from Settings or, with automatic
installation enabled, at launch. For Homebrew installations, run
`brew update` and `brew upgrade --cask pitex`.

Builds from the earlier 2.x line do not update automatically; install 1.0.5
from the downloads below. Pitex Nightly continues to use its separate
update channel.

## Downloads

Downloads include the macOS ARM64 DMG, Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04 AMD64 DEBs,
Windows AMD64 installer and portable ZIP, the Ubuntu installer, and
SHA256SUMS.
Windows remains beta.
